en.title: Far Cry TV Series Assembles Star-Studded Cast Including Batman's Voice
en.summary: FX's anthology adaptation of the popular Ubisoft shooter franchise is building an impressive cast. Hamish Linklater, fresh off voicing Batman, joins Brendan Gleeson and Jennifer Jason Leigh in the upcoming series.
en.body:
The sprawling world of **Far Cry** is set to expand beyond our screens with an ambitious TV series adaptation for FX, and the casting news is nothing short of spectacular. Joining the previously announced **Rob Mac** (who also serves as co-showrunner alongside **Noah Hawley**) and **Lizzy Caplan** are a host of acclaimed actors. Among the new additions are **Brendan Gleeson**, **Jennifer Jason Leigh**, **Hamish Linklater**, **Jamie Demetriou**, and **Sam Spruell**. According to FX, all these talents are slated to appear in the first season, promising a deep bench of performances.

Fans of **Jennifer Jason Leigh** will recognize her from critically lauded roles in **The Hateful Eight** and **Fargo**. **Sam Spruell** recently made an impact in **Game of Thrones: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms**, while **Jamie Demetriou** is a familiar face to viewers of **Only Murders in the Building**. Perhaps most intriguing for fans of animated storytelling is **Hamish Linklater**, whose distinctive voice brought the Dark Knight to life in **Batman: Caped Crusader**. **Brendan Gleeson**, a powerhouse performer known for films like **The Banshees of Inisherin**, also brings significant star power to the project. For those keeping track, **Steve Buscemi**, a multiple Emmy winner, has also been confirmed, adding yet another layer of gravitas to the ensemble.

## A New Take on the Far Cry Universe

The **Far Cry** video game series, known for its open-world chaos and often eccentric villains, has been relatively quiet since the release of **Far Cry 6** in 2021. While **Ubisoft** is reportedly working on **Far Cry 7** under the newly formed Creative House 1, also known as Vantage Studios, details remain scarce. This new TV series, however, seems poised to forge its own path. With **Noah Hawley**, the creative force behind **Fargo** and **Legion**, at the helm, and the series adopting an anthology format, each season is expected to feature a new setting and a fresh cast of characters. This approach allows for diverse storytelling possibilities, potentially exploring different facets of the **Far Cry** ethos without being tethered to a single game's narrative.

## Fan Expectations and What's Next

The announcement of such a high-caliber cast has certainly generated buzz among the gaming and television communities. While the specific game or lore the series will draw from has been a topic of discussion, showrunner **Noah Hawley** has hinted at a surprising and potentially divisive choice regarding which **Far Cry** game might serve as inspiration. The anthology format itself is a significant departure, suggesting the series might prioritize thematic exploration over direct game adaptation. This could be a clever way to engage both long-time fans and newcomers to the **Far Cry** universe. The series is set to air on **FX**, with streaming availability on **Hulu** and **Disney+**. A release date has not yet been announced, but with production seemingly in full swing and such a stacked cast, anticipation is high for further updates on this promising adaptation.

content_raw: The Far Cry TV series for FX is starting to take shape, as new cast members for the anthology series have been announced. Joining Rob Mac (who is also a co-showrunner alongside Noah Hawley) are Lizzy Caplan and Steve Buscemi, along with several new faces, including Brendan Gleeson, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Hamish Linklater, Jamie Demetriou, and Sam Spruell. According to FX, all of those actors will appear in the first season of Far Cry, making for a pretty stacked cast. Leigh earned acclaim for her roles in Hateful Eight and Fargo, Spruell was recently seen in Game of Thrones: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms, Demetriou will be a familiar face to anyone who is a fan of Only Murders in the Building, and Linklater's distinctive voice can be heard in Batman: Caped Crusader, where he plays the Dark Knight. Gleeson is also a big name, having recently starred in Spider-Noir and The Banshees of Inisherin, but if we're talking absolute cinema, you'll know him best for his role as Knuckles McGinty in in each season, so you likely won't want to get too attached to any of the actors in the show's first batch of episodes. As for the Far Cry game series, things have been very quiet since 2021, following the release of Far Cry 6. Ubisoft is reportedly working on Far Cry 7, with the IP now falling under the umbrella of Creative House 1 AKA Vantage Studios . Alongside other big Ubisoft IP like Assassin’s Creed and Rainbow Six, Vantage Studios is focused on scaling and extending these established franchises. Chinese multinational technology and entertainment conglomerate Tencent also holds a significant stake in the subsidiary, having invested $1 billion in it.
